tags.description: Flat tags for categorization and discovery.

upstream_id.description: Reference to the upstream service for this route.

match.description: Protocol-scoped inbound matching rules. Exactly one of {http|grpc} must be present.

plugin_ref.description: Plugin GTS identifier. Builtin plugins use a fixed named instance (e.g. `...~cf.core.oagw.required_headers.v1`); custom (Starlark) plugins use their own anonymous instance identifier (e.g. `...~<uuid>`, returned by `POST /plugins`) — never a bare UUID with no GTS prefix.

config.description: Plugin-specific configuration (shape defined by the referenced plugin). Values must be strings — the wire DTO is a string-to-string map.

items.description: Plugin binding. The wire DTO (`PluginBinding` in oagw/src/api/rest/dto.rs) requires this object shape — a bare string or bare UUID array element does not deserialize.
List of plugins applied to this route, each an object binding a plugin_ref (builtin or custom) with optional config.

rate_limit.description: Rate limiting configuration for the route.

http_match.description: HTTP match rules (used when the upstream protocol is HTTP).

methods.description: HTTP methods supported by this route.

query_allowlist.description: White-listed query parameters. If empty, allow none.

path_suffix_mode.description: How to treat /{path_suffix} from the proxy URL. 'disabled' rejects path_suffix usage; 'append' appends it to path.

grpc_match.description: gRPC match rules (used when the upstream protocol is gRPC).

rate_limit.description: Route-level rate limit. Unlike upstream.rate_limit, this has no `budget` property: hierarchical budget allocation/sharing is validated and pool-enforced only for upstream rate limits (domain/services/management/budget.rs; a route's bucket is always keyed by the route's own id, never a shared pool_owner_id) — a route-level `budget` would be silently inert.

sharing.description: Sharing mode for rate limits. enforce: descendants cannot exceed this limit.

algorithm.description: Rate limiting algorithm. token_bucket allows bursts; sliding_window prevents boundary bursts.

capacity.description: Maximum burst size (bucket capacity). Defaults to sustained.rate if not specified.

cost.description: Tokens consumed per request. Useful for weighted endpoints.

response_headers.description: Include X-RateLimit-* headers on responses. In a hierarchical merge, this field is not independently inherited: the effective rate_limit is selected wholesale (the stricter of ancestor vs. descendant by requests/second), and response_headers travels with whichever whole config wins — a descendant's own response_headers value has no effect if its rate_limit loses the min-rate comparison.

allowed_origins.description: Allowed origins. Use ['*'] for any origin (not recommended with credentials).

expose_headers.description: Headers exposed to browser (beyond CORS-safelisted headers).

allow_credentials.description: Allow credentials (cookies, auth headers). Requires specific origins (not '*').
